items.title: NSE IPO RHP Analysis: What Are You Actually Buying?
items.subtitle: India's largest exchange is coming to market through a pure offer for sale. The prospectus says a great deal about the business, the money and the risks. The one thing it cannot yet say is the price.
items.excerpt: Most IPO conversations start with the price band and work backwards. This one has to run the other way, because the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) has filed its offer document but not yet announced a price band. With nothing to anchor on, a reader is forced to look at the business first.
